roles.label: Super Admin
roles.functional: Can do everything Content Admin can, plus deletion, plus organisation configuration, plus team & role administration.
roles.notes: The account owner. Powers nobody else should have: organisation settings, domain management, role administration, deletion, audit export.

roles.label: Content Admin
roles.designation: Recruitment Manager / HR Manager / Recruiter / HR
roles.functional: Can do everything Manager can, plus edit across the organisation, publish, plus offer & BGV control.
roles.notes: Day-to-day operator. Replaces previous Recruiter Login.

roles.label: Manager
roles.data_access: Own team and own requisitions only (stored as Yes for allowed actions)
roles.functional: Can do everything User can, plus approve/reject within their team, plus view their team's reports.
roles.notes: Approving line manager and interviewer. Sees their team's hiring, not the whole organisation (Yes/No matrix collapses scope to Yes).

roles.label: User
roles.data_access: Own records only (stored as Yes for allowed actions)
roles.functional: Base. Can raise and cancel their own requests and see status of what they raised.
roles.notes: The requester. Employee who needs a hire approved or is referred in. No access to anyone else's data.

roles.label: IT & Admin Ops
roles.functional: Not part of the recruitment hierarchy. Separate functional role limited to onboarding provisioning.
roles.notes: Closes a security gap — separates system access creation (email, role mapping tooling) from User.

roles.label: BGV Vendor
roles.data_access: Assigned BGV cases only (stored as Yes for allowed actions)
roles.functional: Not part of the recruitment hierarchy. Access to nothing except BGV cases assigned to them.
roles.notes: External party. Sees candidate documents needed for verification. No jobs, other candidates, or general dashboard.

roles.label: Viewer
roles.functional: Read only. Cannot take any actions.
roles.notes: Keep for leadership and auditors who need visibility without change rights.
